title: Deterministic Temporal Embedding for Calcium Imaging Trace Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2611.26522v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable extraction of calcium-dependent fluorescence traces in calcium imaging sequences requires identifying pixels whose fluorescence intensity reflects the same underlying cellular activity. We present a deterministic temporal embedding framework that maps pixel-wise fluorescence traces to a low-dimensional representation in which temporally coherent sources form spatially coherent regions. Starting from a fuzzy-neighborhood graph and spectral initialization, we optimize a class-balanced cross-entropy objective using exact sparse attraction and a deterministic particle-mesh decomposition of the dense repulsive interaction with sparse edge compensation, avoiding stochastic negative sampling. The resulting latent representation is spatially decoded into reliable source supports for trace extraction without imposing an explicit cellular shape prior. translated_title: 面向钙成像信号轨迹提取的确定性时序嵌入方法
translated_abstract: 在钙成像序列中可靠地提取钙依赖性荧光信号轨迹，需要识别其荧光强度反映同一潜在细胞活动的像素。我们提出了一种确定性时序嵌入框架，将逐像素的荧光轨迹映射到低维表示中，使时间上相干的活性源形成空间上相干的区域。从模糊邻域图和谱初始化出发，我们采用精确的稀疏吸引项以及带稀疏边补偿的稠密排斥项的确定性粒子-网格分解来优化类别平衡的交叉熵目标，从而避免了随机负采样。所得的潜在表示经过空间解码即可得到用于信号轨迹提取的可靠源支撑区域，而无需施加显式的细胞形状先验。在合成数据和体内双光子钙成像数据上的实验证明了该方法的稳健性。
tldr: 该论文提出一种确定性时序嵌入框架，通过避免随机负采样的确定性优化方法，将钙成像中逐像素荧光轨迹映射到时间相干源形成空间相干区域的低维表示，从而无需细胞形状先验即可可靠提取钙成像信号轨迹。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a deterministic temporal embedding framework that maps pixel-wise fluorescence traces to a low-dimensional representation where temporally coherent sources form spatially coherent regions, avoiding stochastic negative sampling to enable reliable calcium trace extraction without explicit cellular shape priors.
